description: Prices a number of users (1 or more) from the published prices: unit price, total per period and per year, yearly saving, the calculation and the pricing page. Use it for any total: a team, several users, or one user over a year, even as an example; call it as soon as a team size or period is known. Never compute a total yourself. Unit prices and plans: voir_offres.

facturation.description: Billing: mensuel (monthly) or annuel (yearly). Without it, both.

langue.description: Language of the buyer's question (en, fr, es): always pass it, the pages and answers are in this language.

plan.description: Key or name of the plan, as returned by voir_offres. Without it, every plan.

sieges.description: Number of users (seats) to price, as the buyer gave it. Ask for it rather than assume one.

name: devis
title: Price a quote
